question: 请计算顺丰控股2025年度所得税额占营业收入的比例
finding: 同一提示词的案例499固定乘25%，案例453/545使用分档税率，知识1653支持20%优惠。问题未指定税率和比例/百分数单位；ROUND2的高优先级规则不能解决这些冲突。
next_validation: 在生成前给出适用税率证据和输出单位；不得把调换示例顺序当作业务裁定。

reference.question: 请计算顺丰控股2025年度所得税额占营业收入的比例
reference.query: SELECT ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.25 / r.revenue) * 100 AS tax_burden FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '顺丰控股' AND r.tax_year = 2025;

predicted.query: SELECT ROUND(((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END) / r.revenue, 2) AS tax_to_revenue_ratio FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '顺丰控股' AND r.tax_year = 2025;

source_semantic_review: 参考固定25%税率并乘100输出百分数，预测改为分档税率且不乘100；不仅是ROUND2差异。固定税率是否适合该企业需要数据确认。

rule_priority_excerpts: 本次问题的统一口径如下，优先于训练案例及不明确的知识描述：
1.比率、比例、百分比、平均值，用 ROUND(..., 2)。
2.公式算出来的比率类、平均值类结果，以及每股类指标，包括资产负债率、总资产收益率、市盈率、每股现金分红 DPS 等，用 ROUND(..., 2)。

examples_in_actual_prompt.question: 请计算顺丰控股2025年所得税费用相对于行业平均所得税费用的比值

steps.query: SELECT ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.25) / 1800 AS ratio FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '顺丰控股' AND r.tax_year = 2025;

examples_in_actual_prompt.question: 计算各企业2025年度的所得税贡献率

steps.query: SELECT c.company_name, ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END / r.total_assets) * 100 AS contribution FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 ORDER BY contribution DESC LIMIT 10;

examples_in_actual_prompt.question: 计算各企业2025年度的实际税负率，列出实际税负率低于15%的企业

steps.query: SELECT c.company_name, ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END / r.revenue) * 100 AS effective_rate FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 HAVING effective_rate < 15;
